messages.subject: plotDensity
parts:
Hi,
I think in plotDensity() there is a bug in how it handles '...'
arguments. There are two separate functions to which it passes the
'...' argument so that the end effect is that neither can take it and
gives errors. So, for example, if I try to put in parameters to the
density() function about the smoothing it kicks up an error. The error
goes away if I have the '...' argument go only to the actual plotting
part. This is a problem in both the AffymetrixCelSet and
AffymetrixCelFile functions.

Best,
Elizabeth

The two parts of the function that both take the '...' are:
suppressWarnings({
subset <- identifyCells(cdf, indices = subset, types = types,
..., verbose = less(verbose))
})
plotDensity(df, subset = subset, ..., col = col[cc],
lty = lty[cc], lwd = lwd[cc], annotate = FALSE, add =
add,
verbose = less(verbose))
